summary: Faraday Future filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 detailing a September 15 amendment to a $10 million senior convertible note held by an institutional investor under a May 15, 2026 securities purchase agreement, plus a related amendment to the East West Bank deposit account control agreement securing that note. The changes permit prepayment of principal and interest and establish a flexible repayment schedule. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake, or deal price is stated; this is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
